title: Tasty mead

# Tasty mead

Type: Mead | Internal ID: MeadTasty | Source: Fermenter | Usage: Drinking | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Mead base: Tasty x1 | Duration: 10s | Cooldown: 10s | Health Regen: -50% rate | Stamina Regen: +100% rate

# Introduction

Tasty mead is a Black Forest-tier consumable item fermented from Mead base: Tasty.

## Recipe

Mead base: Tasty is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 10 Honey
• 10 Raspberries
• 5 Blueberries
Six Tasty meads are produced by fermenting the mead base for two in-game days.

## Effect

Grants the following effects when consumed:
• Health regen -50%
• Stamina regen +100%
Like all other meads, the player cannot consume another tasty mead while the effect is active, but unlike the stamina meads, there is no cooldown. Once the effect ends, a second mead can be immediately consumed.
The stamina regeneration effect will be interrupted if the user performs any action that normally consumes stamina, such as attacking or sprinting. Tasty mead may be useful in boss fights due to its short cooldown period and dramatic restorative effects.
Note: "-50% health regen" does not drain health, it merely slows regeneration.

## Other locations

Other than brewing the meads, they can be found by destroying Dvergr barrels or Ancient pots.
